entities.summary: Juan Manuel Santos, a notable figure in the history of Colombia, associated with Peace Process, Paramilitaries, and Post-Conflict Colombia (2012–2017). Preceded by 'False positives' scandal — thousands of civilians killed by army and Plan Colombia — billions in U.S. military aid. Their legacy influenced FARC peace agreement signed — September 26, 2016 and Santos awarded Nobel Peace Prize — October 7, 2016.
